differential_oracle.implementation: JSON-value-based reference interpreter compared against the production typed-state interpreter
differential_oracle.coverage: all 12 frozen traces plus 13 adversarial mutations: session lifecycle, wrong bundle identity, digest failure, expired bundle, uncertainty re-entry, uncertainty loss across session boundaries, revocation across sessions, stale-resource claims, intermittent connectivity, non-sensitive egress, resume without interruption, verification outside an active session, and repeated violation occurrences
differential_oracle.limits: same maintainers and frozen fixture; implementation-diversity cross-check only, not external clinical adjudication or a formally verified specification
differential_oracle.state_model_scope: finite abstract graph exploration for session state, bundle identity/validity/digest, revocation monotonicity and uncertainty handoff; separate from the trace parser but not formal verification of clinical correctness
